newsitem.title: USA: Kramer group holds First Enterprise stake.
newsitem.headline: Kramer group holds First Enterprise stake.

text.p: A group including Kramer Spellman L.P. said Monday it acquired a 7.05 percent stake, or 371,300 common shares, of First Enterprise Financial Group Inc's 5,265,335 shares outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the shares between Jan. 8 and 17 at prices ranging from $9.281 to $11.250 per share.
The filing said the group paid approximately $4,152,052 for the shares and that it holds the stake for investment.
Other members of the group named in the filing were Orin S. Kramer and Jay Spellman.
